_comment: Engine-specific DME UDS payloads for exhaust flap control (Pop-Bang).
Each row is the write / read our tool issues against the DME.
DME target address on G-series (G20/G22/G30/F30/F90 etc.) is 0x12 by convention,
verify with your own car's SGBD on E-Sys / INPA. The exhaust flap DID differs
per engine family and sometimes per I-step - fill this in from your OWN research
and your OWN car's CAFD. Common search terms: 'FGS_Abgasklappe', 'ABGAS_KLAPPE',
'exhaust flap workshop coding', E-Sys 'Abgasklappe' function block.
When the running engine's family is not listed below, the tool refuses to write
and tells the app so. Add rows, never guess.

popbang_open.description: FILL THIS IN. IOControl (2F): did + 03 00 for ShortTermAdjustment or 00 for ReturnControl; some communities use 2E write to a coding DID. Not shared here because the exact value is not knowable without the car's CAFD.

popbang_close.description: FILL THIS IN. Usually the Return-Control-To-ECU response (00) to the same DID.

read_status.description: Optional: a DID whose byte reports the current flap position (0 closed, 1 open) when the user wants live state.

_notes: require_parked: refuse any write while the gear is not P or the car is above walking speed - CDS proxy gives the state.
require_engine_on: no point opening the flap without the engine on, and avoids DME bus wake on a parked cold car.
hold_max_ms: user holding the pedal too long -> tool itself sends the close payload after this many ms.
cooldown_ms: between two open requests, to not hammer the gateway.
